review.decision: Verify committed ledger ordering and readable direct-user journal history at reservation and submission
review.notes: Fourth independent review observed a stale cycle timestamp and a disabled journal retaining its former tail. Test the original paths with isolated real journal files. Only earlier committed observations can bound a legacy message. Every direct-user authorization must cover its retained source range and authorship audit.

cases.description: A late asynchronous ingest cannot hide a pause before enrollment; disabled or incomplete direct-user history cannot authorize a reminder.
cases.setup: Legacy user workspace message with a producer batch spanning it, or an explicitly verified original direct event in a real isolated journal.
cases.action: Ingest a pause and a later unrelated stop at an old cycle timestamp; recheck a direct event before and after disabling its journal or losing source history. Exercise the normal binding, pump and final input guard.
cases.expected: Old observations use ledger commit order. A disabled or unverifiable interval stays blocked; a still-valid direct instruction and genuinely newer confirmation remain eligible for one guarded action.
